title: 用于Horn逻辑推理的高质量嵌入
summary: 本文提出并评估了多种生成逻辑语句数值嵌入的方法，通过三元组损失训练，引入重复项锚点生成、难易平衡的正负样本及周期强调困难样本等策略，以提升下游推理效率。
summary_en: This paper introduces and evaluates several approaches to creating embeddings for logical statements using triplet loss, with strategies like repeated-term anchors, balanced positive/negative examples, and periodic hard example emphasis, improving downstream reasoning efficiency.
